trans-unit.source: To avoid the overwrite of your existing translations by the source strings, make sure to enable the Skip untranslated files option and send only fully translated files to your Help Center. We'll use the heuristic mechanism to identify translations in your file(s). Please check whether all translations were uploaded properly.
